results:
Head is `fc2f0891` on `ui/v15.1-1018`, one commit on top of `01dd7770`. I did not re-walk it on the emulator, so the two HIGH fixes are checked by tests and goldens only.

**Checks:** analyze is clean. The unit suite is 6027 passing, with one `SessionLock` timing flake that passes alone. In the full golden run, 15 failed. Nine were `motion_repair_ending_*` and pass when run alone. The other six are the goldens I changed on purpose.

**HIGH 1, Today header clipped the time at 360 dp: fixed.**
- The line now uses a shared one-line notice, also used by Review. It draws a step smaller, never under 84%, and wraps only at very large text. The time is never cut.
- The tests at 360 and 330 dp check no ellipsis, one line, no clash with Mobi and no taller header. The 330 case covers the scaled path.
- I added a 360 golden of the failed-refresh header, `today1018_notrefreshed_360` (day and night).
- In the test font the line fits at natural width at 360, so the golden does not show the scaling the phone needed.

**HIGH 2, Suggested lead title cut ("Practise your weakest cha..."): fixed.**
- The lead card's title no longer has a line cap, so a third line appears when it needs one. The failure card keeps the same behaviour.
- A new test `hero_title_whole_test.dart` swaps through every card that can lead, at 360 and 412 dp and at 1.0x and 1.3x text, and checks the title is whole. It fails with the old cap.
- I opened old and new goldens for `today_rich_fold1_360_text130` and `today_suggested_rest_360_text130`. The old ones had the cut baked in ("Repair your last ..."). The new ones show "Repair your last paper" in full and the cards below shifted down a line.

**MEDIUM items**
- **Two balances on the You tab: not changed.** The server still holds two pools until migration `20261018210000_one_credits_balance` ships (not on staging yet). One-balance wallet UI is planned for v15.2. A single number now would be untrue.
- **Week sheet mixed state: fixed.** The line now reads "You have not planned your days yet. Every day you study still counts." It no longer says "study days" beside "3 of 4 study days". The planned weekdays live only on the phone, so a cleared app really has none. Day and night goldens updated.
- **Failure card drops Mobi from the header: intended.** The card carries its own Mobi, and the header code says never two Mobis on one screen. No change.
- **Rig issues (statement timeouts, missing RESEND_API_KEY): rig, not the app.** No change.
- **Suggested hint "only twice": not walked, but covered.** An existing test checks it shows on the first two visits only and never after a swipe. It passes.

On your timeline question: I can't confirm 9 pm. What I can say is that these round-1 findings are fixed. The round-2 emulator walk, the APK build and the install on your phone are still ahead, and I haven't done them.

The emulator, Gradle and the device `10BF370PA6002XR` were not touched. No dart_defines were committed.
